p: Nebo: Which was a part of mount Abarim, Nu 27:12.
he buried him in a valley: That is, the angel of the Lord, Jude 1:9.
this day: That the Jews might not have opportunity to commit idolatry by it.
Joshua the son of Nun was: By this the favour of God is demonstrated, in that he does not leave his Church destitute of a governor.
face to face: To whom the Lord revealed himself so plainly as in Ex 33:11.
hand: Meaning, the power of God working by Moses in the wilderness.
